attempts.text: [{"name": "item_trend", "idea": "Short-term momentum: distinct buyers in the last 3 days and the ratio of buyers in the last 7 days to the 7 days before, to separate rising items from fading ones that i_buyers7 alone ranks equally.", "level": "article", "sql": "SELECT article_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN customer_id END) AS ag_buyers3, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN customer_id END) + 1.0) / (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t_dat < DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN customer_id END) + 1.0) AS ag_trend7_14 FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY article_id;"}, {"name": "item_age", "idea": "Days since the article's first sale in all history, to capture the new-arrival effect that drives next-week purchases.", "level": "article", "sql": "SELECT article_id, date_diff('day', MIN(t_dat), DATE '{A}') AS ag_age_days FROM tx GROUP BY article_id;"}, {"name": "item_repeat_online", "idea": "Share of 90-day buyers who bought the article on 2 or more distinct days, which marks repurchasable basics, plus the article's online-channel share.", "level": "article", "sql": "WITH b AS (SELECT article_id, customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t_dat) AS d, AVG(CASE WHEN sales_channel_id = '2' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS o FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY article_id, customer_id) SELECT article_id, AVG(CASE WHEN d >= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ag_repeat_share90, AVG(o) AS ag_online_share90 FROM b GROUP BY article_id;"}, {"name": "same_product_code", "idea": "The user's 90-day transaction rows and recency on other articles with the same product_code (the same model in another colour or size), a strong signal for H&M purchases.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ut AS (SELECT t.customer_id, t.article_id, a.product_code, t.t_dat FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id JOIN articles a ON t.article_id = a.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY), ca AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, a.product_code FROM cand c JOIN articles a ON c.article_id = a.article_id) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.article_id, COUNT(ut.t_dat) AS ag_samecode_tx90, COALESCE(MIN(date_diff('day', ut.t_dat, DATE '{A}')), 91) AS ag_samecode_recency FROM ca LEFT JOIN ut ON ut.customer_id = ca.customer_id AND ut.product_code = ca.product_code AND ut.article_id <> ca.article_id GROUP BY ca.customer_id, ca.article_id;"}, {"name": "user_dept_index_share", "idea": "Normalized 90-day share of the user's rows in the candidate's department and index group (a proxy for gender and age segment), to filter out mismatched global candidates.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ut AS (SELECT t.customer_id, a.department_no, a.index_group_no FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id JOIN articles a ON t.article_id = a.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY), tot AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ut GROUP BY customer_id), dep AS (SELECT customer_id, department_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ut GROUP BY customer_id, department_no), ig AS (SELECT customer_id, index_group_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ut GROUP BY customer_id, index_group_no), ca AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, a.department_no, a.index_group_no FROM cand c JOIN articles a ON c.article_id = a.article_id) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.article_id, COALESCE(dep.n, 0) * 1.0 / tot.n AS ag_dept_share90, COALESCE(ig.n, 0) * 1.0 / tot.n AS ag_idxgroup_share90 FROM ca JOIN tot ON tot.customer_id = ca.customer_id LEFT JOIN dep ON dep.customer_id = ca.customer_id AND dep.department_no = ca.department_no LEFT JOIN ig ON ig.customer_id = ca.customer_id AND ig.index_group_no = ca.index_group_no;"}]
